keyPhrases.text: so rich, complex, and beautifully rendered one is reminded of the theater's primal power to touch the soul
sweeps the audience into its heartbreaking tale
so compelling that the collective gasp of the audience hung in the air

reasoning: This is clearly a rave review with superlative language throughout ('primal power to touch the soul,' 'brilliant direction,' 'uniformly flawless performances,' 'spectacular cast'). The reviewer places it in the company of acclaimed works like 'August: Osage County' and describes profound audience reaction. No meaningful criticisms are present - even the 3+ hour runtime is presented neutrally as part of the epic scope.
